title: Control-Plane Route Inheritance And Local Xdist Load Hardening 2026-06-30
purpose: Close the control-plane defects observed during the NR-5 verifier: launcher-pinned Codex pager route did not survive a manual commit_executor retry without ambient env, and pre-push-fast/audit_fast under unbounded xdist auto overloaded JS subprocess parity tests. Keep the fix in tooling/control-plane surfaces only.
evidence_command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_commit_executor_receipt.py mu/tests/tools/test_pipeline_agent_pager.py mu/tests/tools/test_executor_dispatch.py mu/tests/tools/test_orchestrator_mode_switch.py --tb=short && bash -n mu/tools/audits/audit_fast.sh && bash -n mu/tools/hooks/pre-push-fast && bash -n scripts/green_gate.sh && python3 tools/checks/enforce_l4_execution_contract.py --staged --wave-id control-plane-route-xdist-hardening-2026-06-30 --wave-class L4_ENABLER && git diff --check
evidence_delta: (1) Reproduce and lock the route leak found during NR-5: a launcher config with pager_route=codex emitted normal pipeline events as codex, but a direct commit_executor retry with only --handoff and --bus-dir fell back to committed pipeline_agent_pager.route=both. (2) Carry the wave-owned pager route through routing record, handoff, commit executor lifecycle/pre-commit-supervisor pager emissions, and retry/continuation paths without relying on an ambient RCX_PIPELINE_AGENT_PAGER_ROUTE_OVERRIDE shell variable. (3) Add a durable local pre-push/audit_fast worker cap or equivalent grouping so JS subprocess parity tests cannot false-red from unbounded xdist auto fanout; keep an explicit env override for larger machines.
progress_proof_before: PR #1187 completed NR-5 only after manually rerunning commit_executor with PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS=4. The retry event stream recorded requested_targets=["codex","claude"], route="both" despite the wave config pinning pager_route="codex". The first uncapped pre-push-fast failed on JS subprocess 60s timeouts, while focused serial/xdist tests passed and the capped rerun passed.
progress_proof_after: A no-env commit_executor retry against a handoff from a codex-routed launch emits commit lifecycle and pre-commit-supervisor events with route="codex" and requested_targets=["codex"]. Local pre-push/audit_fast defaults to a bounded worker count for JS-heavy suites or otherwise proves a bounded xdist shape, while preserving documented override behavior.
